environment.description: Node.js 18 service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no managed rule groups). PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with the application role granted SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all tables in the public schema. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic with X-Forwarded-For headers. No query-level firewall or pgAudit configured. The database role has USAGE on public schema and can access pg_catalog views.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default HTTP/HTTPS listeners, no WAF association
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, app role: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on public.assets, public.users, public.audit_log
config.network: VPC with ALB in public subnet, ECS tasks in private subnet, RDS in isolated subnet accessible from ECS security group on port 5432
